text: Tina, a Swedish customs officer with a heavy, Neanderthal face, can smell guilt and shame on the travellers she stops. Then [a strange man named Vore|trigger|an outsider reaches in] comes through with a box of maggots and a scar on his tailbone just like hers. In her house in the woods he tells her [she is a troll|origin|old beliefs and legends], and she starts eating grubs from the trees, while helping police hunt the people [trafficking abused infants|wrong|harm done to children] and wondering about [the baby in Vore's taped-up fridge|threat|impostors and doubles].
